scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description:
Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana is one of the flagship health schemes of the Government of India. 

It was launched on September 23, 2018. 

The scheme aims to provide health coverage to economically vulnerable populations. 

The primary objective is to offer a health insurance cover of up to INR 5 lakh per family per year. 

This coverage is for secondary and tertiary healthcare services. 

The scheme targets over 10 crore families across India. 

This translates to approximately 50 crore individuals. 

The beneficiaries are selected based on the Socio-Economic Caste Census data from 2011. 

The scheme aims to reduce out-of-pocket expenditure on health services. 

It seeks to ensure access to quality healthcare services for the underprivileged. 

The scheme covers a wide range of medical procedures. 

These include hospitalization expenses, surgeries, and pre- and post-hospitalization costs. 

The coverage includes both public and private hospitals. 

Beneficiaries can avail of cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of preventive healthcare. 

It includes health promotion and awareness initiatives. 

The Ayushman Bharat scheme is implemented through a network of State Health Agencies. 

These agencies are responsible for the operationalization of the scheme at the state level. 

The scheme is funded jointly by the Central and State Governments. 

The Central Government contributes 60% of the funding. 

The State Governments contribute the remaining 40%. 

The eligibility criteria for beneficiaries are based on socio-economic status. 

Families identified in the SECC 2011 are automatically eligible. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility. 

The scheme does not require any educational qualifications. 

To apply for the scheme, beneficiaries must follow a specific process. 

They need to visit the nearest Common Service Center or designated health facility. 

Required documents include proof of identity and residence. 

Beneficiaries must provide details of their family members. 

After verification, eligible families receive an Ayushman Bharat card. 

This card is essential for availing of the benefits under the scheme. 

The scheme also provides for portability. 

This means beneficiaries can access services across the country. 

The disbursement of funds is done directly to the empaneled hospitals. 

This ensures a cashless experience for the beneficiaries. 

The scheme has been a significant step towards Universal Health Coverage. 

It aims to reduce the financial burden on families due to health expenses. 

The scheme also promotes the establishment of health and wellness centers. 

These centers focus on preventive healthcare and early diagnosis. 

As of October 2023, over 1.5 crore hospital admissions have been recorded under the scheme. 

The scheme has been instrumental in providing timely healthcare services. 

It has also led to the empanelment of over 25,000 hospitals across the country. 

The scheme has a robust grievance redressal mechanism. 

Beneficiaries can lodge complaints through a dedicated helpline. 

The helpline number is 14555. 

The scheme has also been recognized internationally. 

It has received accolades for its innovative approach to healthcare delivery. 

The Ayushman Bharat scheme is a part of the broader Ayushman Bharat initiative. 

This initiative also includes the establishment of health and wellness centers. 

These centers aim to provide comprehensive primary healthcare services. 

The government has allocated significant funds for the implementation of the scheme. 

In the Union Budget for 2023-24, INR 6,400 crore was allocated for the scheme. 

The scheme has been instrumental in addressing the healthcare needs of marginalized communities. 

It has also contributed to improving health indicators in the country. 

The scheme has a strong focus on maternal and child health. 

It provides coverage for maternity benefits and newborn care. 

The scheme also covers mental health services. 

This includes treatment for mental illnesses and disorders. 

The government has partnered with various stakeholders for effective implementation. 

These include non-governmental organizations and healthcare providers. 

The scheme has been a game-changer in the Indian healthcare landscape. 

It has significantly improved access to healthcare for the poor. 

The scheme has also enhanced the quality of healthcare services. 

Beneficiaries have reported positive experiences with the scheme. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the scheme's performance. 

Regular assessments are conducted to identify areas for improvement. 

The Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana is a landmark initiative. 

It represents a commitment to ensuring health equity in India. 

The scheme is a vital step towards achieving Sustainable Development Goal 3. 

This goal aims to ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all. 

The scheme has the potential to transform the healthcare system in India. 

It empowers individuals and families to seek necessary medical care without financial strain. 

The government remains committed to expanding the reach and impact of the scheme. 

Efforts are ongoing to include more families and enhance service delivery. 

The Ayushman Bharat scheme is a testament to India's dedication to public health. 

It reflects a holistic approach to healthcare that prioritizes the needs of the vulnerable. 

The scheme is a crucial part of India's journey towards universal health coverage.
